title: What clients say
subtitle: Real results from real businesses we have worked with.

items.name: Maria Alvarez
items.quote: Sentellix rebuilt our entire booking and reminder flow. No-shows dropped by 40 percent in the first month and I got my evenings back.

items.name: James Carter
items.quote: Their AI follow-up system contacted 60 cold leads I had given up on. Two of them closed within six weeks. That alone paid for the year.

items.name: Priya Shah
items.quote: What I appreciated most was the honesty. They told us we did not need a custom agent, just a smarter automation. It saved us thousands.

items.name: Sophie Bennett
items.quote: Setup was painless and the handover documentation is genuinely good. We run the system ourselves now and it just works.
